name: web-form-monitoring-7-kaih
description: Aplikasi Web Form Monitoring 7 Kebiasaan Anak Indonesia Hebat (7 KAIH) - VERTIKAL SMA 2026 Kemendikdasmen RI

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.slice(1); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not Found'); } const ext = path.extname(p); const mime = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.tsv': 'text/tab-separated-values', '.json': 'application/json' }; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': mime[ext] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }); server.listen(3000, () => console.log('Local Server aktif di http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Kemendikdasmen RI / Tim Pengembang 7 KAIH
